candidate.answerReason: Counting each corner on both adjacent sides gives 24 side-post counts. The shorter and longer sides consequently have 4 and 8 posts, giving dimensions 12 by 28 yards and area 336 square yards.

methods.label: Count posts on the four sides
methods.explanation:
Counting the posts separately along each side counts every corner twice and every other post once. Thus the four side counts add to
\[
20+4=24.
\]
Opposite sides of the rectangle have equal lengths and therefore equal post counts. Each longer side has twice the post count of each shorter side, so the four side counts have ratio \(1:1:2:2\). These are six equal shares altogether. Each share is \(24\div6=4\), giving \(4\) posts on each shorter side and \(8\) on each longer side.

A side with posts at both endpoints has one fewer gap than posts. The side lengths are therefore
\[
(4-1)\cdot4=12\text{ yards},
\qquad
(8-1)\cdot4=28\text{ yards}.
\]
The area is
\[
12\cdot28=336\text{ square yards}.
\]
The answer is \(336\), choice B.
